headline: Kenya's KCB Group Reports Sh57 Billion Profit, Raises Stake in DRC Unit
summary: KCB Group posted a profit of Sh57 billion as its loan book grew 12.8% to Sh1.28 trillion, while expanding its ownership stake in its DRC subsidiary.
why: KCB Group is Kenya's largest financial services conglomerate with extensive regional operations across East and Central Africa.

impacts.name: KCB Group
impacts.why: Higher net profits and loan growth directly boost shareholder returns.
